decision_rationale: This is a new single-cell foundation model with explicit cell-text pretraining and cross-modal language alignment, so it is not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. The only generative language is in the LLM-based text-augmentation pipeline; the candidate model itself is described and evaluated as a cross-modal pretrained model with retrieval and annotation tasks, not a generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: “cross-modal Cell-Language pre-training framework”; “after pretraining on 32M cell-text pairs”; “LLM-based workflow with retrieval-augmented generation enriches cell textual descriptions”
